content.short: Cyfrin provides blockchain code reviews and full audits to help web3 developers prepare for audits.
content.description: Cyfrin is a team of developers focused on elevating the web3 developer experience. We provide code reviews that examine smart contracts, tests, and documentation to prepare teams for a full audit. Our reviews deliver a practical report with best-practices guidance and concrete recommendations, along with a checklist of steps to take before deploying to mainnet or starting an audit. For full audits, we scrutinize every line of code to ensure the implementation behaves as intended.
